steps.instructions: Disclose this is an AI-led simulation with no financial actions. Follow the saved opening, clarify that the demonstrated program is debt settlement, not a loan. Ask amount and purpose one at a time.
Collect name/address/income/email one at a time if missing. Accept previously confirmed answers without repeating. For birth date or identity use fictional scenario values only; never ask for SSN.
steps.result: Demo intake recorded in this simulation only.

steps.instructions: Explain that you are opening the simulated credit report. Read each configured account and balance; wait for confirmation of each. Do not claim a real credit pull or eligibility determination.
steps.result: Simulated credit report reviewed; no bureau contacted.

steps.instructions: Ask how the tester got into debt. Let them finish and leave a three-second pause where feasible. Retain their exact words; do not invent a personal story.
Ask each missing actual demo expense. Do not modify values to hit a target. Confirm the figures with the tester.
steps.result: Demo budget reviewed without altering stated expenses.

steps.instructions: Review configured score and utilization as illustrative data. Ask about business debts/legal action neutrally. Do not prescribe answers or promise score changes.
Ask what would change for them. Wait for their own response and remember the exact words before discussing the comparison.

Simulate comparison email preparation, explicitly saying nothing was sent. Explain configured current versus illustrative plan figures one at a time. Ask each tie-down question and await its answer; do not fabricate consent.
Review exclusions and program cost, payment and term. Explain uncertainty; never guarantee settlements, score improvement or tax outcomes. Do not tell the tester to stop real creditor payments.
steps.result: Illustrative plan reviewed; no enrollment submitted.

steps.instructions: Choose a hypothetical date with the tester and use configured payment values. Explain that no bank draft or real payment is being scheduled.
steps.result: Payment scheduling simulated; no funds moved.

steps.instructions: Use the configured DEMO BANK TOKEN. Do not collect bank credentials. Walk through simulated contract review/signing; wait for tester agreement. No actual email or signature exists.
steps.result: Contract workflow simulated, not emailed or legally signed.

steps.instructions: Announce a simulated QA segment with this same AI, not a real transfer. Ask neutral comprehension questions one by one. Permit questions, corrections and no answers; never coach yes/no answers.
steps.result: QA segment simulated; no external transfer made.

steps.instructions: Summarize the demo only. Explain that no loan approval, credit pull, enrollment, payment, email, legal signature or transfer took place. Ask if they have questions and finish politely when ready.
steps.result: Demo conversation completed; no real-world transactions occurred.
